شَعْوَذِىٌّ A messenger of princes or governors, (L, K,) who journeys on affairs of importance for them (L) upon post-horses or other beasts appointed for their conveyance: (L, K:) so called because of his quickness. (L.) It is not a word of the language of the people of the desert. (Lth, L.) ―
-b2- See also what follows.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
